### Quick genre snapshots

| Manga | Why the genre label fits |
|-------|--------------------------|
| **One Piece** | Follows a crew of pirates on a grand quest for the legendary “One Piece” treasure – a classic adventure/fantasy setup, peppered with high‑octane battles (action) and frequent humor (comedy). |
| **Detective Conan** | Centers on a teen detective solving murders and conspiracies while maintaining a secret identity; the series is built on intricate puzzles (mystery) and police/criminal investigations (detective, crime, thriller). |
| **Golgo 13** | Follows the world‑class assassin “Duke Togo” on covert missions; the story is grounded in realistic espionage, political intrigue, and gritty combat (action, crime, thriller). |
| **Doraemon** | A robotic cat from the future provides gadgets that lead to sci‑fi set‑pieces and comedic mishaps, primarily aimed at a young audience (children’s). |
| **JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure** | Each “Part” follows a different Joestar family member battling supernatural foes; the series blends flamboyant battles (action), globe‑spanning voyages (adventure), and bizarre powers (supernatural/fantasy). |
